description: Data and code: A Multilevel Analysis of Post-Harvest Food Loss in Sub-Saharan Africa: Commodity, Food Supply Stage, and Regional Interactions is published by Kwakye, Elvis. The package combines cleaned post-harvest loss observations with R code for multilevel analysis. Its stated coverage is 36 sub-Saharan African countries; five cereals and multiple supply stages, 2019 to 2024. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists CSV resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. It derives from FAO data but adds a specific cleaned analysis dataset and code not explicitly covered by the parent catalogue record. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
